# Folio CV

Folio CV is a free web-based CV and resume builder. It helps users write structured resume content, compare templates, customize visual styling, preview the result, and export the finished document as a PDF.

## What it does

Folio CV provides a guided resume-building workflow with sections for personal details, work experience, education, skills, languages, design settings, live preview, and PDF export.

## Who it's for

Folio CV is for students, early-career professionals, freelancers, creatives, and experienced candidates who need a clear resume or CV for applications.

## Key features

- Live resume preview
- Multiple CV and resume templates
- Design customization for fonts, colors, accents, sidebars, dividers, and page colors
- A4-oriented preview
- PDF export
- No registration required for Basic CV creation and PDF export
- Folio CV Pro for login access, saved CVs, AI tools, and application tracking

## Pricing

Folio CV Basic is free to use. No credit card is required for the core resume-building workflow.
Folio CV Pro is available as weekly, monthly, and yearly subscriptions:

- Folio Pro Weekly: EUR 2.99 per week
- Folio Pro Monthly: EUR 9.90 per month
- Folio Pro Yearly: EUR 79.90 per year
